description: Exterior view of interior courtyard at O'Keeffe's Abiquiu house; adobe textured walls, wooden plank door with walking stick leaning on it, wellhead with circular wooden plank cover, flagstone or large bricks creating a horizontal pathway running in front of door and behind wellhead; abstract view of the courtyard accentuating the flatness of the geometric shapes -  the wooden door juxtaposed to the adobe wall, the circular 3-dimensional wellhead casting a shadow in the foreground, the leaning stick, the flagstones and the beauty of the dirt on which all the planes and shapes intersect and sit.
title: Interior Court
